chunks.text: STS/UC/01, section 1 Scope, clause 1.1: This specification covers a printed digital camouflage ripstop woven fabric, polyester and cotton blend, intended for combat uniform shirts and trousers.
STS/UC/01, section 1 Scope, clause 1.2: Material supplied against this specification shall be tested and inspected as laid down in Sections 3 to 5 and shall comply with all requirements.

STS/UC/01, section 2 Test Methods, clause 2.1: Tests shall be carried out by the methods listed below on specimens conditioned in the standard atmosphere for testing textiles (20 +/- 2 C, 65 +/- 4 % relative humidity).

STS/UC/01, section 2 Test Methods, clause 2.1: Test methods: ISO 1833 Textiles. Quantitative chemical analysis (fibre composition); ISO 3801 Textiles. Woven fabrics. Determination of mass per unit length and mass per unit area; ISO 7211-2 Textiles. Woven fabrics. Construction. Determination of number of threads per unit length; ISO 13934-1 Textiles. Tensile properties of fabrics. Part 1; Maximum force, strip method; ISO 13937-2 Textiles. Tear properties of fabrics. Part 2: Trouser shaped test specimens; ISO 5077 Textiles. Determination of dimensional change in washing and drying; ISO 105-C06 Textiles. Tests for colour fastness. Colour fastness to domestic and commercial laundering; ISO 105-X12 Tests for colour fastness. Colour fastness to rubbing; ISO 105-B02 Tests for colour fastness. Colour fastness to artificial light (xenon arc); ISO 105-E04 Textiles. Tests for colour fastness. Colour fastness to perspiration; ISO 3071 Textiles. Determination of pH of aqueous extract; ISO 105-J03 Textiles. Tests for colour fastness. Calculation of colour differences

STS/UC/01, section 3 Physical And Chemical Requirements, clause 3.0: The material shall conform to the requirements of Table 1. Failure in any one requirement shall render the lot liable to rejection.

STS/UC/01, section 3 Physical And Chemical Requirements, clause 3.1 (Table 1 columns: characteristic, direction, method, unit, requirement): Fibre composition (polyester) - ISO 1833 % 62 to 68 (test method ISO 1833 Textiles. Quantitative chemical analysis (fibre composition))

STS/UC/01, section 3 Physical And Chemical Requirements, clause 3.2 (Table 1 columns: characteristic, direction, method, unit, requirement): Mass per unit area - ISO 3801 g/m2 190 to 210 (test method ISO 3801 Textiles. Woven fabrics. Determination of mass per unit length and mass per unit area)

STS/UC/01, section 3 Physical And Chemical Requirements, clause 3.3a (Table 1 columns: characteristic, direction, method, unit, requirement): Threads per cm Warp ISO 7211-2 threads/cm Not less than 40 (test method ISO 7211-2 Textiles. Woven fabrics. Construction. Determination of number of threads per unit length)

STS/UC/01, section 3 Physical And Chemical Requirements, clause 3.3b (Table 1 columns: characteristic, direction, method, unit, requirement): Threads per cm Weft ISO 7211-2 threads/cm Not less than 30 (test method ISO 7211-2 Textiles. Woven fabrics. Construction. Determination of number of threads per unit length)

STS/UC/01, section 3 Physical And Chemical Requirements, clause 3.4a (Table 1 columns: characteristic, direction, method, unit, requirement): Breaking force (strip) Warp ISO 13934-1 N Not less than 850 (test method ISO 13934-1 Textiles. Tensile properties of fabrics. Part 1; Maximum force, strip method)

STS/UC/01, section 3 Physical And Chemical Requirements, clause 3.4b (Table 1 columns: characteristic, direction, method, unit, requirement): Breaking force (strip) Weft ISO 13934-1 N Not less than 600 (test method ISO 13934-1 Textiles. Tensile properties of fabrics. Part 1; Maximum force, strip method)

STS/UC/01, section 3 Physical And Chemical Requirements, clause 3.5a (Table 1 columns: characteristic, direction, method, unit, requirement): Tear force (trouser) Warp ISO 13937-2 N Not less than 35 (test method ISO 13937-2 Textiles. Tear properties of fabrics. Part 2: Trouser shaped test specimens)

STS/UC/01, section 3 Physical And Chemical Requirements, clause 3.5b (Table 1 columns: characteristic, direction, method, unit, requirement): Tear force (trouser) Weft ISO 13937-2 N Not less than 30 (test method ISO 13937-2 Textiles. Tear properties of fabrics. Part 2: Trouser shaped test specimens)

STS/UC/01, section 3 Physical And Chemical Requirements, clause 3.6a (Table 1 columns: characteristic, direction, method, unit, requirement): Dimensional change after washing Warp ISO 5077 % Within +/- 3 (test method ISO 5077 Textiles. Determination of dimensional change in washing and drying)

STS/UC/01, section 3 Physical And Chemical Requirements, clause 3.6b (Table 1 columns: characteristic, direction, method, unit, requirement): Dimensional change after washing Weft ISO 5077 % Within +/- 3 (test method ISO 5077 Textiles. Determination of dimensional change in washing and drying)

STS/UC/01, section 3 Physical And Chemical Requirements, clause 3.7a (Table 1 columns: characteristic, direction, method, unit, requirement): Colour fastness to washing, change in shade - ISO 105-C06 grade Not less than 4 (test method ISO 105-C06 Textiles. Tests for colour fastness. Colour fastness to domestic and commercial laundering)

STS/UC/01, section 3 Physical And Chemical Requirements, clause 3.7b (Table 1 columns: characteristic, direction, method, unit, requirement): Colour fastness to washing, staining - ISO 105-C06 grade Not less than 3.5 (test method ISO 105-C06 Textiles. Tests for colour fastness. Colour fastness to domestic and commercial laundering)

STS/UC/01, section 3 Physical And Chemical Requirements, clause 3.8a (Table 1 columns: characteristic, direction, method, unit, requirement): Colour fastness to rubbing, dry - ISO 105-X12 grade Not less than 4 (test method ISO 105-X12 Tests for colour fastness. Colour fastness to rubbing)

STS/UC/01, section 3 Physical And Chemical Requirements, clause 3.8b (Table 1 columns: characteristic, direction, method, unit, requirement): Colour fastness to rubbing, wet - ISO 105-X12 grade Not less than 3 (test method ISO 105-X12 Tests for colour fastness. Colour fastness to rubbing)

STS/UC/01, section 3 Physical And Chemical Requirements, clause 3.9 (Table 1 columns: characteristic, direction, method, unit, requirement): Colour fastness to light - ISO 105-B02 blue wool Not less than 5 grade (test method ISO 105-B02 Tests for colour fastness. Colour fastness to artificial light (xenon arc))

STS/UC/01, section 3 Physical And Chemical Requirements, clause 3.10 (Table 1 columns: characteristic, direction, method, unit, requirement): Colour fastness to perspiration - ISO 105-E04 grade Not less than 4 (test method ISO 105-E04 Textiles. Tests for colour fastness. Colour fastness to perspiration)

STS/UC/01, section 3 Physical And Chemical Requirements, clause 3.11 (Table 1 columns: characteristic, direction, method, unit, requirement): PH of aqueous extract - ISO 3071 pH 5.5 to 7.5 (test method ISO 3071 Textiles. Determination of pH of aqueous extract)

STS/UC/01, section 3 Physical And Chemical Requirements, clause 3.12 (Table 1 columns: characteristic, direction, method, unit, requirement): Shade against approved reference (CMC 2:1) - ISO 105-J03 Delta E Not more than 1 (test method ISO 105-J03 Textiles. Tests for colour fastness. Calculation of colour differences)
STS/UC/01, section 4 Visual Inspection, clause 4.0: The full width of the sample shall be examined on a lit inspection table. Defects shall be classified as Major or Minor as given in Table 2.
STS/UC/01, section 4 Visual Inspection, clause 4.1 (Table 2 columns: defect, requirement, class): Holes, tears, cuts None permitted Major
STS/UC/01, section 4 Visual Inspection, clause 4.2 (Table 2 columns: defect, requirement, class): Pattern or print defects (misprint, missing print, smear) None permitted Major
STS/UC/01, section 4 Visual Inspection, clause 4.3 (Table 2 columns: defect, requirement, class): Stains larger than 5 mm None permitted Major
STS/UC/01, section 4 Visual Inspection, clause 4.4 (Table 2 columns: defect, requirement, class): Spots up to 5 mm Not more than 2 per linear metre Minor
STS/UC/01, section 4 Visual Inspection, clause 4.5 (Table 2 columns: defect, requirement, class): Local discoloration or shade bands None visible at 1 m under daylight Major
STS/UC/01, section 4 Visual Inspection, clause 4.6 (Table 2 columns: defect, requirement, class): Loose or floating threads Not more than 3 per linear metre Minor
STS/UC/01, section 5 Sampling And Acceptance, clause 5.1: One laboratory sample of not less than 2 m full width shall be drawn from each lot.
STS/UC/01, section 5 Sampling And Acceptance, clause 5.2: A lot shall be accepted only when the sample meets every requirement of Section 3 and no Major defect of Section 4 is found.
STS/UC/01, section 5 Sampling And Acceptance, clause 5.3: Minor defects within the limits of Table 2 shall not be cause for rejection.
STS/UC/01, section 5 Sampling And Acceptance, clause 5.4: Where a characteristic of Section 3 has not been tested, the lot shall not be accepted until the result is available.
STS/UC/01, section 5 Sampling And Acceptance, clause 5.5: Every failure shall be recorded on the test report with the clause number.
STS/UC/01, section 6 Marking, clause 6.1: Each roll shall be marked with the specification number (STS/UC/01), lot number, roll number, length and width (nominal 150 cm).
